player_intent: The equipped firearm is visible on the back or hip while both hands are occupied by traversal.
acceptance_rule: Traversal creates only a cosmetic mesh copy following a non-overriding bone attachment. After support releases, overlap imported AGLS upper-body equip with the neutral climb tail and exit settling; the exit modifier must not freeze the live upper body. Keep the copy visible until exit settling and evaluated hand transfer complete. Support IK stays released during equip; combat interrupts cosmetic recovery without delaying gameplay.

nodes.role: Read-only spine or hip follower; never overrides a bone pose.

Begins stow in traversal and clears it on exit or death.

visual_check: Inspect primary hang/pull-up, exit settling, and early/middle/late AGLS equip. Inspect pistol separately. No physical strap or authored entry-unequip is claimed; hand transfer contact remains a visual approval item.

system_delta.reason: Keep the canonical palm weapon and existing visibility owner. Add one geometry-only bone follower instead of reparenting gameplay nodes or duplicating weapon scripts.
